rules.cue: 同一退款订单涉及 N 个品类时
rules.reason: When a single refund order spans multiple categories, split the refund equally across those distinct categories rather than by transaction amount, so category net sales reflect per-category refund shares.

rules.cue: 跨品类退款按该订单中各品类商品数量之和加权分摊
rules.reason: When a refund spans multiple categories, allocate it by summed item quantity per category in the order rather than equally or by sales share, so category net sales reflect quantity-weighted refund shares.

rules.cue: 相同 refund_id 只认第一次
rules.reason: When the refund file may contain duplicate rows for the same refund_id due to repeated collection, keep only the first occurrence per refund_id before computing any metrics so later duplicates are not deducted again.
